hub.releaseNotes: Stability and protection update — fixes a rare freeze when reopening the app while signed in, starts up smoothly while the restaurant server boots, stronger protection against abuse, and clearer error messages with one-tap retry on every screen.

spot.releaseNotes: Stability update — devices keep their pairing through connection blips and hub restarts, friendlier error messages with one-tap retry everywhere, and fixed adding items to an order on some networks.
